claim_scores.rationale: Sets `dspy.configure(..., track_usage=True)` and calls the predictor via `prog(...)`, which is normal `Module.__call__` usage that attaches usage to the returned `Prediction`.
Custom `LM(DummyLM)` manually calls `usage_tracker.add_usage(..., total_tokens=7)` on each forward, and later asserts `total_tokens == 7` for each result.
Uses one shared predictor instance `prog` and submits it twice through `dspy.Parallel`, matching the same-predictor concurrent scenario.
Checks `res[0].get_lm_usage()` and `res[1].get_lm_usage()` separately and asserts each returned `Prediction` has its own `total_tokens` value of 7.
Includes `time.sleep(0.1)` inside the LM call so the two parallel tasks overlap and exercise the threaded boundary.
Uses `DummyLM` as the backend with canned country-to-capital outputs, keeping the example offline and deterministic.
